fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.name: Potential 7za.DLL Sideloading
fields.query: event.type="ModuleLoad" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (module.path contains "\7za.dll" and (not ((src.process.image.path contains "C:\Program Files (x86)\" or src.process.image.path contains "C:\Program Files\") and (module.path contains "C:\Program Files (x86)\" or module.path contains "C:\Program Files\")))))
